hints: The teams all leave at once and travel in parallel. Nobody waits for anybody else, so the total elapsed time is decided by one location only.
Everything is supplied once the SLOWEST location has been reached - so the answer is the maximum of dist[], not the sum.
Check reachability before taking the maximum, or an INF entry becomes your answer. Any unreachable vertex means the whole thing returns -1.
source: Core of NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 4 Practice Question 2
title: Minimum total time (the Q2 rule)
